body:
OBSERVED (2026-08-01): packages/init/lib/gitignore-defaults.mjs ADLC_GITIGNORE_LINES ignores '.adlc/*' and negates only config.json, tickets.json, tickets/, ticket-archive/, and specs/. There is NO negation for '.adlc/manifest.jsonl' (the C11 evidence ledger ADR-0015 describes as committed) nor for '.adlc/manifest.d/' (the segmented store). Consequence today: every repository initialized with adlc-init keeps its manifest evidence LOCAL-ONLY — gates record evidence that never reaches the remote, so CI, clones, and reviewers see an empty ledger, and rails-guard-ci's append-only check has nothing committed to protect. Consequence once forest mode ships (see the dual-mode enable ticket): the activation marker .adlc/manifest.d/.store.json would also be ignored, so mode would silently diverge per checkout. The ADLC repo itself is unaffected only because its hand-maintained .gitignore adds the negations (lines 34 and 46-49): '!.adlc/manifest.jsonl', '!.adlc/manifest.d/', '!.adlc/manifest.d/**', then re-ignores '.adlc/manifest.d/.lineage' and '.adlc/manifest.d/*.lock' — that file is the reference behavior.

FIX: extend ADLC_GITIGNORE_LINES to append, after the existing entries: '!.adlc/manifest.jsonl', '!.adlc/manifest.d/', '!.adlc/manifest.d/**', '.adlc/manifest.d/.lineage', '.adlc/manifest.d/*.lock'. Order matters: the re-ignores for .lineage and *.lock MUST come after the manifest.d negations (gitignore last-match-wins), mirroring the ADLC repo's own .gitignore exactly. The constant is deliberately a single-line array literal for the mutation gate's array-literal-shrink operator — keep it single-line. Check how init consumes the constant (append-if-missing vs whole-block write) and make sure repos initialized with the OLD defaults get the new lines on re-run (init's existing idempotent line-adding behavior should cover this; verify by reading packages/init's scaffold logic and add a test if re-run does not add missing lines).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
AC1 — fresh init: in a temp git repo, run the init scaffold; then `git check-ignore .adlc/manifest.jsonl` exits non-zero (NOT ignored) and, after creating the directory, `git check-ignore .adlc/manifest.d/` exits non-zero, while `git check-ignore .adlc/manifest.d/.lineage` and a probe for '.adlc/manifest.d/x.lock' exit 0 (still ignored). Verify: new test in packages/init/test/ using a real temp git repo; note the existing lesson that check-ignore probes on not-yet-created directories need a trailing slash or a real directory — create the directory in the fixture before probing.
AC2 — re-run upgrade: a repo whose .gitignore already holds the OLD default block gains the new negation lines on re-running init, without duplicating existing lines. Verify: test writing the old block first, running the scaffold, asserting each new line appears exactly once.
AC3 — full suite green: npm test.

PROCESS NOTE: single-line array constant is load-bearing for the mutation gate (see the comment above the constant); do not reformat it.
title: init gitignore defaults never commit the manifest: add negations for .adlc/manifest.jsonl and .adlc/manifest.d/, keeping .lineage and locks ignored
